verdict.rationale: a-Shell has automation surfaces: Apple Shortcuts actions, the .profile startup script and an optional relay server. Nothing in the evidence shows any first-party way to version, review history of, or roll back those automations. The relay README describes only a user-supplied .profile hook, with no versioning or changelog mechanism, so the applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
